summary: Iter 379 validation. BUG 1 (P&L breakdown) and BUG 2 (language switcher + AI auto-translate of staff content) both verified end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass; UI flows for P&L expand/collapse/drill, sidebar translation (Luganda + Francais + back to English), persistence across reload, and Luganda calendar titles in Sept 2026 all behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: translate.py pins model name 'claude-sonnet-5-5' — confirm this alias is intentional (unusual spelling); if the model id changes the whole switcher silently falls back to English because exceptions are swallowed by design.

Fallback path in translate_batch returns English without a user-facing hint of failure. Acceptable per product decision, but logs are warning-only — consider surfacing a last_error timestamp on cache-stats for observability.
P&L breakdown sums reconciled within tolerance for sampled accounts (test asserts <=2% drift).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Report dropdown + Location dropdown on /reports are custom combobox components (not native <select>); click the trigger text and then click the option by text. Globe switcher button text toggles between 'Eng'/'Lug'/'Fra' etc. localStorage key for persistence is '5812_lang'. Luganda first-switch LLM call completes in ~12-15s for ~45 nav strings; subsequent switches are near-instant (Mongo cache). P&L row testids use account code: pnl-row-<code>, pnl-breakdown-<code>, pnl-drill-<code>, drill modal is pnl-drill-dialog. Calendar event test testids are cal-item-<id>. Proper nouns (e.g. 'Magoggo Kids Club') correctly remain untranslated per LLM instructions.
